title: Chapter structure file
description: Language-neutral narrative skeleton for one chapter: story-section order, segment order, and who is speaking. Carries no visible text. A story section is a division of the TEXT, not a runtime Scene; Scene / Shot / Beat composition lives in experience/ and is documented in docs/text-experience-binding.md.

$schema.description: Optional editor hint; not part of the data.

sourceFile.description: Path to the original public-domain chapter this was adapted from.

sections.description: Story sections in reading order. A section groups consecutive segments of the text; it does not describe how they are staged.

segments.description: Segments in reading order. One segment is one short sentence: the narrative atom that the experience displays, reads aloud, highlights, and translates.
